capabilities: Install a food-assistant module of Markdown instructions and working notes
Generate a seven-day weekly menu with a prepared Copilot prompt
Track purchases, consumption, waste and stock corrections
Create recipe drafts and product cards from templates
Keep menu history and shopping lists
disambiguation: Not an AI assistant of its own; it installs Markdown instructions and a prepared prompt for the separate Copilot plugin.
extras: Module scenarios and instructions are currently in Russian only; requires Obsidian desktop 1.11.4 or later. The package ships empty working notes and card templates, not a ready-made recipe database. The clipboard is overwritten with the prompt only after an explicit action, and the plugin never reads previous clipboard contents.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for recipes, pantry stock, weekly menus and shopping lists, and no ready-made agent workflow for planning meals.

relations.evidence: opens Copilot Agent Chat with a prepared weekly-menu prompt
Copilot and Dataview are separate community plugins that must be installed and configured independently

summary: Local-first module that installs Markdown instructions and working notes for recipes, inventory, weekly menus and shopping lists, driven by Copilot.
